neighbours.label: The verbs 'prepare' and 'preparing' (dense, weak pole; best guess at the top token)
fire: She spent the afternoon collating, analysing and preparing information for the mapping team.
Inspectors order tests, map the cracks and spalls and prepare drawings, specifications and repair details.
The site has undergone some prescribed burning to prepare it for seeding and planting.
We are preparing a long report for the committee, and it will be ready in a week.
The cook was preparing the vegetables while the guests arrived at the old house.
To prepare for the exam, the students met every Saturday in the library.
Farmers prepare the soil in early spring and sow the first rows by April.
He prepared a short speech and practised it twice in front of the mirror.
